ns2:section.sectionText: Arts Experiences for Incarcerated Youth. In this course students design and facilitate a weekly arts (music, visual art, dance, drama) experience for youth detained at the Champaign County Detention Center. Weekly class will be held either in Music Building 1140 or at the detention center. 1 hour of lab time each week is by arrangement. Not intended for students with Freshmen standing.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
